messages.body: Canonical repository is now pdbsy/quantpass-arbitrum-hackathon. Existing Macbeth01–05 task directories have independent canonical checkouts. Old source worktrees and PRs remain preserved; do not continue publishing AlphaForge work to the old repository. This migration PR preserves source authorship, target engineering controls and protected user UI. Worker self-confirmation on the new repository remains unverified; this notice does not assign new work. No merge, deployment, transaction broadcast, mainnet or real funds are authorized.

PR 11 closeout is NOT_READY; retain Draft and do not merge. All eleven protected Dashboard inputs have explicit dispositions and unchanged source hashes. The canonical read-only Worker report/search view is selectively adapted; the unauthenticated local-post writer is rejected for activation. Original UI, CSP and old sources are preserved.

Actual master rules now require Linux, Windows, macOS, CodeQL and Dependency Review, plus one approval, CODEOWNER and last-push approval with no bypass. The sole collaborator cannot provide independent approval; GOV-001 and SUPPLY-001 remain OPEN.

Forge has executed 20 passing digest-only tests, including 13 x 256 fuzz cases and a dedicated invariant with 64 runs / 2048 calls / zero reverts. Slither actually ran but its unchanged fail-pedantic gate exits 255 for one informational mixed upstream pragma finding; this remains FAIL. No filter, dependency rewrite, deployment, signature or broadcast was used. Final-head application/browser/CI evidence follows in this same PR after the C/R/S evidence commits.

Agent-ID validation is workflow/process identity consistency, not cryptographic identity assurance.
